payload.rationale: The selected excerpts establish only that this is a DRAFT NPDES permit fact sheet prepared July 30, 2021 for proposed reissuance of permit NM0020583, with the prior permit expiring October 31, 2021. The DRAFT label describes the administrative status of the 2021 proposal document; it does not, by itself, establish that associated numeric discharge limits and monitoring requirements are not enforceable or governing for Federal FY2025. The packet also provides no evidence that a final NPDES permit was issued and effective for NM0020583 during Federal FY2025, so it cannot establish that those limits and requirements are enforceable or governing for that period either. Without evidence on final-permit status during the evaluation window, neither affirmative closure nor negative closure on FY2025 enforceability is supported.
